
## Trailer initialization crash and navigation focus

- Remove the blocking yt-dlp quality check and its unused Python runtime. Play the highest verified native rendition directly, retaining the native legacy fallback.
- Keep the active trailer selected while expanding to fullscreen so background focus changes cannot restart or replace it. Record explicit trailer dismissal reasons for diagnosis.
- Require recent explicit Up/Left/Back input before entering top/side navigation from content. Removing a focused button or completing an action no longer authorizes the menu to expand automatically; restore content focus instead.
- Preserve movement inside navigation and between its centre/dropdown areas. Log rejected automatic menu focus for targeted diagnosis.

Signed 32-bit build. Physical-TV confirmation of fullscreen expansion and all remote navigation journeys is still required.
